title: An Oracle WebLogic console is exposed
summary: The WebLogic admin console is reachable.  WebLogic has a long run of remote code execution flaws.

confirm.control: A path that cannot exist, so the site's not found answer is known.
confirm.differential: status==200 and (body_contains("WebLogic Server") or body_contains("Oracle WebLogic")) and body_differs(control)

remediate: Keep the console off the public internet and WebLogic patched.
